headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Risk Alerts
summary: Integrate real-time dependency risk alerts and enhance the audit process to include more granular checks, such as command expansion in binding.gyp files. Improve user experience by providing detailed explanations of potential risks and offering mitigation strategies.
actions: Implement real-time dependency risk alerts based on public trend signals like 'deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype' for identifying emerging security threats.
Expand the audit process to include more granular checks, such as command expansion in binding.gyp files, similar to the approach taken by 'rddmwmddr/android-ad
Provide detailed explanations and mitigation strategies for potential risks detected during the installation process, inspired by tools like 'interplains/Zero-B
